description.value: Stewart's Lodge & Camps is a family-run wilderness resort on Nimpo Lake in BC's remote Chilcotin region, operating since 1953. Guests choose from 10 lakeside log cabins or fly-in-only outpost cabins on private backcountry lakes, with activities including fishing, flightseeing over Tweedsmuir Provincial Park and the Rainbow Mountains, hiking, and watercraft rentals. It serves as a basecamp for one of BC's most scenically dramatic and otherwise unreachable backcountry areas.

address.value: 21173 Chilcotin-Bella Coola Hwy, Nimpo Lake, BC V0L 1R0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active wilderness resort operating since 1953 on Nimpo Lake in the Chilcotin. Laundry is explicitly listed as a cabin amenity for Cabins 01 and 02 on the /log-cabins subpage. No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, e-bike charging, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so these remain null; the website also confirms the OSM toll-free phone number while additionally listing a local number (250-742-3388) not captured in OSM.
concerns: Website lists a local phone number (250-742-3388) not present in OSM; OSM only captures the toll-free (1-800-668-4335).
No street address available in OSM or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable wilderness resort with a functioning website, booking system, and 2026 copyright date. A legitimate accommodation stop for cyclists exploring the Chilcotin.
